text: The Calogero Vinti Prize is given by the Italian Mathematical Union to an Italian mathematician who is not older than 40, in appreciation of their contributions to Mathematical Analysis. The prize is named in honor of the Italian mathematician Calogero Vinti and is presented during the Italian Mathematical Union's conference, which occurs every four years. In addition to the Calogero Vinti Prize, the Italian Mathematical Union awards other prizes, including the Caccioppoli Prize, the Bartolozzi Prize, and the Stampacchia Medal. A list of all recipients of the Calogero Vinti Prize up to the year 2022 is available.
